changes.title: Combat waiting space
items: Waiting creatures move farther around the fight, with deliberate close passes and room to pursue wounded animals.
Turning lunges warn with an outward wave of red dots that flares as they prepare to attack.

changes.title: Lunge tracking
items: Creatures can turn during lunges, with tracking strength available for species balancing.

changes.title: Mushroom light controls
items: Mushroom light controls let you adjust halos, colour pools and cap glow.
An optional row of nine pickable mushrooms near the dancefloor lets you compare the colours.
